description: This file provides a utility function 'safeWriteJson' for safely writing JSON data to a file with directory creation, file locking, backup, and rollback mechanisms. It uses external modules like 'fs/promises', 'proper-lockfile', and 'stream-json' for file operations, locking, and JSON streaming.

methods.name: safeWriteJson
methods.description: Asynchronously writes JSON data to a specified file path, ensuring directory creation, file locking, backup of existing files, and rollback on errors.

methods.name: _streamDataToFile
methods.description: Streams JSON data to a file using stream-json components to handle large data efficiently.
